objects.name: Analytic 2274
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a process invoking screen capture Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) targeting an Human-Machine Interface (HMI) or operator workstation window, where the calling process is not a recognized Industrial Control System (ICS) vendor application or approved remote support tool, immediately followed by an image file write. OT operational-fidelity gate: Do not alert on novelty, scan/read volume, or enumeration alone. Alert when the source role is not authorized for discovery/polling and the target scope, address/tag range, protocol, or rate deviates from the established operational baseline. Suppress normal SCADA/HMI/historian polling, commissioning, asset inventory, backup, diagnostics, and approved engineering activity.
